detail.title: Compositional Heredity and Error Thresholds in Prebiotic Systems
detail.summary: Error thresholds govern the stability of informational systems. In prebiotic regimes, copying fidelity must exceed specific error-correction bounds to prevent mutational meltdown of the system's compositional state.
detail.reason: Connecting digital information theory models with prebiotic error thresholds.
